name: 章を途中まで表示して全文へ進む
prompt: Redesign this Japanese chapter-list component as a single 390×440 image, matching the native preview exactly in crop, typography, positions, row spacing and button geometry. The native Japanese preview is authoritative for wording and layout. The attached user image is palette guidance only. Keep the entire page background pure white with no tint. Preserve the heading 章の一覧, the five numbered chapter rows, all labels and their order, and the bottom すべて表示 action. Convert the pale mint action fill to one flat solid forest-green button (#047857) with white text; no gradient, tint, texture, shadow or highlight. Keep chapter labels near-black and row numbers neutral gray. Preserve the same rounded pill shape, width, height and position of the action. Exact Japanese copy: 章の一覧; 1 第1章：心が居場所を知った場所; 2 第2章：言葉を使わずに語る土地; 3 第3章：顔と声、つながりの心; 4 第4章：時間と記憶に響くもの; 5 第5章：山々の間に刻まれた夢; すべて表示. Do not add icons, cards, extra rows, English, or other copy. No tinted surfaces.
reviewNotes: White page and tint-free button pass; tighten list pitch and flatten green action fill in one correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
